findings.location: source.html, first stanza of the Timothy Dwight hymn
findings.source_quote: The church our blest Redeemer / Saved with His own precious blood.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace « A sauvée de son précieux sang » with « Sauvée par son propre sang précieux » so the line says the church was saved by the Redeemer’s blood, not saved from it.
findings.translation_quote: L’Église que notre bienheureux Rédempteur / A sauvée de son précieux sang.
